issues.detail: The instructions do not cover error handling or edge cases, focusing only on the happy path.

scenarios.name: deploy-with-docker
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers all required steps (download, pin image, bind port, run compose) but omits the note about no 'v' prefix; Response B fails to download the correct tag, uses wrong port mapping, and misses the prefix note.

scenarios.name: configure-ai-provider
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully satisfies the rubric, while Response A omits key variables and UI instructions.

scenarios.name: import-bank-statement
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully covers the required steps (endpoint, mapping, filtering, export) while Response A omits the /import/csv endpoint and the name/currency mapping.
